title: Skills Catalog Governance — Skill Fixture
description: Test fixture for grade-skill. Exactly one of expect_exact_output / expected_tools MUST be present.

fixture_id.description: Unique identifier within the fixture set

prompt.description: The prompt / invocation context to supply to the skill

expect_exact_output.description: Expected exact output text (after normalization per REQ-B2). Mutually exclusive with expected_tools.

expected_tools.description: Expected tool names (subset of frontmatter allowed-tools). Mutually exclusive with expect_exact_output.
